config._purpose: EXPLORATORY. Tests a specific prediction another group makes about our own system, at sizes where it can actually appear. [GV21] reports that the cold phase at the penalty-off setting is about N/2^d knots PLUS one closed bipartite 'ribbon' holding the leftover points. Our existing lambda = 0 runs cannot show this: their sizes (64, 96, 160) are all multiples of 16, so the graph shatters into a whole number of 4-cubes with NO leftover, baby_frac reaches 1.000 and there is nothing for a ribbon to be made of. The sizes here are deliberately NOT multiples of 16. PREDICTION, written before the run: in the cold shattered phase, if the leftover forms a single closed piece then largest_frac should equal 1 - baby_frac (the largest piece IS the ribbon) and pieces should be about baby_frac*N/16 + 1; if instead the leftover scatters, largest_frac sits near 16/N and pieces runs well above that. The two differ by far more than the run-to-run spread, so this is decidable. Not pre-registered as a gate; it is a reproduction check of somebody else's reported detail.
config.name: cqg_lam0_ribbon
